assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated.
The service is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management.
The clinical indication notes paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
